To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the genetic basis of resistance to South American Leaf Blight (SAL) was identified and that the resistance determinism for complete or partial resistance was elucidated.

we identified QTLs for the resistance of the rubber tree to South American Leaf Blight, the most important disease of rubber tree, and that the resistance determinism is complex and involves several QTLs.

(1) QTLs for complete resistance to SALB were identified on the consensus map; (2) QTLs common for resistance to all strains were identified; (3) QTLs specific for partial resistance to some strains were identified; and (4) a common QTL for RT and LD was identified.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of QTLs for partial resistance to SALB, using the F1 population obtained from a cross between a susceptible clone and a resistant clone.
the identification of QTLs associated with resistance to SALB.
the development of molecular markers for the identification of QTLs associated with resistance to SALB in rubber tree.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
QTLs for complete resistance are located in a small region of the rubber tree genome and QTLs for partial resistance are located on a large region of the rubber genome.

the resistance to SALB in the rubber tree is a quantitative trait, with a major QTL and minor ones, and that it is controlled by a single gene for complete resistance and by several genes for partial resistance.
the resistance to South-American leaf blight in the rubber tree is a complex polygenic trait.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the QTLs detected on the RO38 parental map and confirmed on the consensus map are good candidates for the genetic improvement of resistance to SALB.
the genetic determinism for resistance is complex and involves a large number of QTLs.
the resistance to SALB is controlled by a major gene, and by several QTLs.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the resistance determinism to SALB is complex and that the resistance to the different isolates is controlled by different QTLs.
